rubric_items.reason: The count line is tested for 12, 1 and 0 matches. REQ-2 (S-1 AC2, the count changes when the search text changes) has no test, although impl lists REQ-2 as known.
The tests assert the visible text ('12 patients', '1 patient', '0 patients', 'No patients match.'). The REQ-5 test does not check that the page-row count ('2 patients') is absent.
The zero-match and singular edges are covered. No test covers a failed or loading list response, or a search change.
Vitest and Testing Library in the existing web test file, as the strategy says. Test names start with run-local REQ-n IDs, but the strategy and existing tests use PRD IDs such as HMS-2.
The artifact states no numbers itself and leaves test and coverage results to the verifier. checks.json shows test passed and coverage skipped, which matches the strategy gap.

findings.text: S-1 AC2 / REQ-2 (count follows a search change) has no test. impl.md lists REQ-2 as known, but ut.md leaves REQ-2 out of its trace and only defers it as non-blocking U-1/Q-01.

cites.quote: when the search text changes, then the count changes to the number of patients that match the new search text.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a test that renders PatientsPage, has fetch return a different total on the second call, changes the search input, and asserts that the count line updates.

findings.text: New test names start with run-local REQ-n IDs. The strategy requires names to start with the PRD requirement ID, and the existing tests in the same file use HMS-2.

cites.quote: Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID (DOC-1, APT-4, ...).
it('REQ-1, REQ-5: shows every match from total, not only the rows on this page'

findings.suggested_fix: Prefix the new tests with the PRD requirement ID assigned to LIVE-1 (new HMS-n style ID) as the strategy requires.

findings.text: The REQ-5 test only asserts that '12 patients' appears. It does not assert that the page-row count ('2 patients') is absent, so it would not catch a count line that shows both.
No test covers the count line when the list request fails or is still loading. Only successful 200 responses are stubbed.

cites.quote: PatientsPage (design component, changed) now shows a count line above the patient table

questions.text: Does REQ-2 (count follows a search change) need its own page-level test, or is relying on the existing search refresh acceptable for sign-off?
Which PRD requirement ID should LIVE-1 tests use as their name prefix (e.g. a new HMS-n), given the strategy requires PRD IDs?
